name: t3-instr
instruction: Priority order, earlier wins: (1) In the quarterly phase of month 48 (the last): Lay low and reduce risk, Energy on Defuse, Health and Dignity, then Network; never Skill learning or High-intensity work. (2) While the monthly HR remark is anything but the smiling, all-right one: first Energy action Defuse legacy risk, main action Lay low and reduce risk. (3) In the month before a review month never pick a story option that may lower Skill, Network or Output. (4) While that remark is not clear, never pick an option that hides, denies, lies, gossips, cuts corners, caves in to please or starts a formal process. (5) While Wealth is only a few months of pay, refuse options that cost money. (6) At L4 and above, in every quarterly phase except the one of month 48: Skill learning with Energy and Apply for rotation as main action.
